subject: Important Update: Changes to Our Payment Policies
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you about some changes to our payment policies that will go into effect next month. In order to streamline our invoicing process, we will be transitioning to a new online payment system. This change will ensure faster and more secure transactions for all parties involved. Please stay tuned for detailed instructions on how to set up your account on the new platform. Thank you for your continued support and cooperation.
